name: a-git-diff-output-flag-still-needs-a-plan
description: 'git diff --output=<file>' writes a file no shell redirect names. It was the disqualifier that kept git on the allowlist honest; since 2026-08-19 the whole word is off the list, so this invocation is refused for the broader reason too, and the narrow one is pinned here in case a future reader is tempted to re-admit git by flag.
